jobs.jdText: <p>P-1348</p> <p>Sr. Software Engineer (L5)</p> <p>Location: Bangalore, India</p> <p>At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems â from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers â and customer obsessed â we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.</p> <p>The Data Platform team builds the Data Intelligence Platform for Databricks, enabling automated decision-making across the company. Working in collaboration with Product Teams, Data Science, and Applied AI, the team develops tools spanning logging, orchestration, data transformation, metrics stores, governance platforms, and data consumption layers. The team functions as a large production customer that uses Databricks products at scale and helps guide the future direction of the platform.</p> <p>The Impact You Will Have<br>- Design and operate the company-wide metrics store that enables business units and engineering teams to share and aggregate detailed metrics with high quality and performance.<br>- Build and maintain the cross-company Data Intelligence Platform, balancing data protection requirements with ease of access as the company scales.<br>- Develop tooling and infrastructure to efficiently manage and run Databricks on Databricks at scale across multiple clouds, geographies, and deployment types.<br>- Design and implement the base ETL framework used by data pipelines across the company.<br>- Build reliable, scalable data pipelines using Databricks and partner products, providing early feedback on product design and operations.<br>- Partner with engineering teams to develop long-term vision and requirements for Databricks products.<br>- Establish conventions and APIs for telemetry, debug, feature, and audit event log data.</p> <p>What We Look For<br>- 5+ years of software engineering experience.<br>- 4+ years of experience providing technical leadership on large-scale data infrastructure projects including ETL frameworks, metrics stores, or infrastructure management.<br>- Experience building and operating reliable multi-region data pipelines at scale.<br>- Experience with workflow orchestration frameworks including tools like Airflow or DBT.<br>- Experience with large-scale messaging systems including Kafka or similar technologies.<br>- Strong cross-functional communication and collaboration skills.<br>- Passion for data infrastructure and enabling others through improved data accessibility.<br>- B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span
